title: Rewrite the AbarvaNav client-routing byte scan as a render test and wire it by named file; keep legacy-setup-links held

scope.judgedWhole: Every test file in the directory is a row. Once one of two runs, the directory is PARTIAL and leaves the dark-directory ratchet's set, so that ratchet can no longer see a third file added beside them. The control pins the directory's on-disk file set to this record in its place.
scope.everyFileWasExecuted: Each file was run on its own with `npx jest --runTestsByPath <file> --no-coverage --ci` on the branch: 2 of 2 green (8 and 5 cases).

rewrite.before: One case. Read the bytes of src/components/AbarvaNav.tsx and asserted the literals 'const navLink = ' and '<Link href={href} prefetch' present and '<a href={href}' absent.
rewrite.after: Eight cases. Renders AbarvaNav in jsdom with next/link replaced by an anchor carrying a marker attribute, and asserts on the rendered DOM: every product nav item for a signed-in admin and client is a prefetched next/link route to the right href; no anchor in the bar lacks the marker (admin, client, signed out); only the current path's item is active; compact omits the product items; the signed-out Investor item is a next/link route. The file no longer imports node:fs.
rewrite.pathKept: The file keeps its .ts path (React.createElement, no JSX) so that T-785's row for it is superseded by this record's row under the same path.

mutations.harness: Each mutation edits src/components/AbarvaNav.tsx, runs both the pre-change byte scan and the new suite by --runTestsByPath, then restores the file.

mutations.summary: Before: 3 of 8 caught, and red on a neutral reformat. After: 8 of 8 caught, green on the reformat.

wiring.step: Run the T-786 AbarvaNav render suite by named file
wiring.whyByFile: Naming the directory would also select legacy-setup-links.test.ts, which is still a source-text scanner over an unreachable component. Retire-or-rewrite for it is the gated half of T-786.

gatedHalf.decision: Retire src/components/__tests__/legacy-setup-links.test.ts (its only surviving surface is listed unreachable, and its register module is testOnly), or rewrite it against a reachable surface.
gatedHalf.status: decision needed — not taken by this record
